question: How different is the minus-source antenna input on the two already-executed, prepared-identical trajectories?
operation: Recompute the fixed minus Gaussian on the exact antenna positions of both the prior plus-source and minus-source native trajectories. Compare the sensor difference due solely to divergent trajectories under the same evaluated field; preserve their actually different neural exposure histories. No CNS or body is rerun.

rivals.A: Realized body divergence creates a material >=0.001 late mean signed L-R change under the common minus field, justifying a short online/yoked switch pilot.
rivals.B: Body divergence and source-to-command response exist but common-field feedback difference stays <0.001; spend next compute on longer horizon/motor speed or validated effector change.
rivals.C: Prepared identity, time correspondence, raw source field or numerical domain fail; geometry cannot be interpreted.

limits: This is an empirical scale screen from fixed left/right exposure, not a run with source relocation at 100 ms and not a formal upper bound on future feedback. It cannot admit Stage4/5.
